proposed.label: Account brief
proposed.proposed: Centerline kilometers need confirming: the 2025 asset management plan lists 255 km of local and 55 km of collector roads (310 km), while Public Works pages say approximately 300 km, none marked centerline. Lincoln's Roads & Transportation page lists "Road signage inventory, inspections, maintenance and repairs" among the work Public Works oversees. In this Ontario jurisdiction, O. Reg. 239/02, s. 12(1) requires inspecting regulatory and warning signs for Ontario Traffic Manual retroreflectivity once per calendar year, each within 16 months of the last. Next step: contact Public Works at 905-563-2799 or publicworks@lincoln.ca and confirm which road length is the centerline figure for their sign inventory.
